Build, customize, and maintain the company's parametric Revit Mechanical Families . Review and audit models produced by Junior/Mid-Level BIM
eligibility_evidence: This includes resolving complex cross-disciplinary clashes, producing fully coordinated shop drawings, ensuring adherence to project specifications and international BIM standards, and providing technical support to junior team members.
